key_highlights: RBA Governor signals rate hikes to cool job market, raising short-term rate fears across ASX (Headline 31, 71)
ASX tech stocks led gains on Wall Street AI rally; broader index treads water amid rate uncertainty (Headlines 33, 65)
Saudi oil shock and global diesel shortage (Iran/Ukraine) send Australian fuel prices surging, pressuring transport and consumer sectors (Headlines 37, 41, 52)
Iron ore downside risk persists, weighing on BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX (Headline 69)
Active ASX gold exploration: Platina, Dalaroo, Advance, Broken Hill, Larvotto all report positive assay/resource updates (Headlines 36, 38, 39, 40, 61, 64)
Sydney housing market in 'bloodbath' mode, compounding rate-sensitive REIT and financials pressure (Headline 70)
Jetstar industrial action escalates with fee waivers, hitting Qantas.AX and QNT.AX sentiment (Headlines 20, 29)
China rebalancing towards robotics; Xi under domestic pressure, adding commodity demand uncertainty (Headlines 46, 57)

sectors.trend: Iron ore faces structural downside; gold exploration names active with multiple positive assays. China's pivot to robotics may reduce near-term commodity demand.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX under pressure from iron ore weakness. Gold juniors (PLA.AX, DAR.AX, BHPG.AX, LRV.AX) attract speculative flows. Diversify away from pure iron ore exposure.

sectors.trend: RBA hawkish tilt supports NIMs but rate fears and Sydney housing 'bloodbath' threaten credit quality and REIT valuations. Corporate bond buyers turning picky signals tighter credit conditions.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX benefit from higher rates short-term but face housing stress. REITs (VGP.AX, SSW.AX) pressured by elevated discount rates. Monitor NIM vs. credit cost balance.

sectors.trend: Saudi oil shock and global diesel shortage (Iran/Ukraine) push fuel prices higher. Trump diesel intervention may distort markets. Energy prices dumping on US political risk.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX benefit from elevated crude. Downstream refiners face margin pressure. Transport (QAN.AX, QNT.AX) hit by fuel cost pass-through.

sectors.trend: AI trade powers global equities; AMD hits $1T, Meta gains via Muse. ASX tech names rally on Wall Street spillover. Data centres strain net-zero targets.
sectors.implications: ASX tech (WES.AX, XRO.AX, SOL.AX) benefit from global AI momentum. Data centre power demand supports energy demand but creates ESG headwinds.

sectors.trend: Jetstar industrial action escalates; fuel price surge pressures consumer spending. Adelaide CBD foot traffic decline signals softening retail.
sectors.implications: QAN.AX, QNT.AX face operational disruption. WES.AX, IAG.AX, WBC.AX consumer exposure under pressure. Watch retail sales data.

sectors.trend: US healthcare litigation environment remains hostile; no major ASX-specific catalyst today. Daicos Brownlow win is cultural, not financial.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX, WES.AX (health) remain defensive anchors. No immediate catalyst; monitor US biotech litigation trends for sentiment spillover.

key_themes: RBA hawkish pivot: rate hike signal to cool labour market dominates rate-sensitive sectors
Commodity bifurcation: iron ore weak, gold active, oil elevated on geopolitical supply shocks
AI/tech global rally lifting ASX tech but data centre energy demand creates structural tension
Housing stress: Sydney 'bloodbath' compounds rate sensitivity for banks and REITs
China structural rebalancing to robotics reduces commodity demand visibility
Industrial action (Jetstar) and fuel costs pressuring transport/consumer
Fiscal risk: federal/state governments near 'debt cliff', Intergenerational Report locks migration

risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce duration in rate-sensitive REITs and growth equities; favour fixed-income ladders and dividend-paying financials

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Global diesel/oil supply shock (Iran, Ukraine, Saudi)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge transport and consumer exposure; consider energy producers (WDS.AX, WLE.AX) as inflation hedges

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore demand deterioration / China slowdown
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into gold and diversified miners
Monitor bank NPL data; reduce REIT exposure; favour defensive healthcare and staples
Avoid QAN.AX, QNT.AX near-term; monitor wage settlement outcomes
Watch sovereign credit spreads; favour cash and short-duration bonds

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold exploration juniors on active assay pipeline
opportunities.rationale: Multiple positive results (Platina, Dalaroo, Advance, Broken Hill, Larvotto) signal sector-wide discovery momentum; gold hedges rate and geopolitical risk

opportunities.recommendation: Add energy producers as oil/diesel inflation hedge
opportunities.rationale: Saudi shock and diesel shortage to 2027 support upstream margins; WDS and WLE benefit from sustained elevated crude

opportunities.recommendation: Selective ASX tech exposure on global AI momentum
opportunities.rationale: AMD $1T and Meta/Muse rally lifting sentiment; ASX tech lags US but benefits from spillover

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore and REIT exposure ahead of RBA hike
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore downside risk plus rate-sensitive REITs face dual headwind from hawkish RBA and China demand softening

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid transport/aviation names amid industrial action and fuel cost spike
defensive_moves.rationale: Jetstar fee waivers signal wage pressure; diesel shortage raises operating costs across QAN and QNT

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain defensive healthcare and staples allocation
defensive_moves.rationale: CSL and SGH provide low-beta income; consumer staples resilient through fuel-driven inflation

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound to mildly lower over 1–3 months. RBA rate hike signal caps upside for rate-sensitive sectors; oil shock adds inflation risk. Tech provides partial offset. Expect ^AXJO volatility around 8,200–8,500.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if RBA pauses after 1–2 hikes. Gold, energy, and healthcare offer structural support. Iron ore and housing remain overhangs. China's robotics pivot may eventually support ASX tech hardware names. Fiscal risk requires monitoring.

US AI capex cycle continuation (Nvidia, AMD, Meta)
